{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)
print("Number of QA test orders:", qa_mask.sum())
print("QA order IDs:", sales.loc[qa_mask, 'order_id'].tolist())

# Remove QA test orders and refunded orders
valid_mask = ~(qa_mask | (sales['status'] == 'refunded'))
print("Number of valid orders after removing QA and refunded:", valid_mask.sum())

# Filter to only converted orders (converted == 1)
converted_mask = (sales['converted'] == 1)

# Final population: converted, valid orders
final_mask = valid_mask & converted_mask
print("Number of converted, valid orders (final population):", final_mask.sum())

# Extract the final dataset
final_data = sales.loc[final_mask, ['channel', 'customer_segment', 'revenue_clean']]

# Display first few rows
print("First 5 rows of final data:")
print(final_data.head())"}
